correspondence.excerpt: Evidence is not Claim.
Evidence is not Proof by mere existence.
Evidence is not Decision, Authority, Admission, or Conformance without an applicable assessment.
This candidate defines Evidence semantics only. It does not certify the adequacy of any evidence set or grant decision authority.
An inspectable, provenance-bound record capable of supporting, weakening, or leaving unevaluable one explicit claim within a declared scope.
scope:evidence-definition
The claim itself.
Automatic proof, truth, acceptance, admission, or authority.
Unscoped output whose subject, origin, or applicability cannot be resolved.
A two-run byte comparison supports deterministic projection identity.
A schema PASS supports shape evidence but does not prove Product meaning or runtime behavior.
CML-07 validation receipts, hostile fixtures, digest checks, and projection comparisons are evidence for particular checks. None can silently become admission or runtime proof.
/home/vrondelli/projects/CyberAlchemy-lab
Evidence is something inspectable that bears on a specific claim. It can help prove or disprove that claim, but it does not decide by itself what is true or approved.
Evidence must identify its claim, subject, provenance, and scope.
Stale or mismatched evidence cannot silently support a current claim.
Evidence assessment and authority decisions remain separate.
E = (evidence_id, claim_ref, subject_ref, provenance, scope, observed_at, currentness, content)
; exists(E) =/=> proves(C);
supports(E,C,Q) only within Q.
Evidence is a provenance-bound observation or record E associated with an explicit claim C, subject S, scope Q, and currentness condition.
Its evidential force is limited to the declared relation support(E,C,S,Q)
; collection, existence, or volume does not establish sufficiency or authority.
One evidence record.
E
The bounded claim that E may support or challenge.
C
The declared scope and applicability conditions.
Q
The evidence identity and source are inspectable.
The supported or challenged claim is explicit.
The claim does not exceed the evidence scope.

unresolved_notes: Current C29 Evidence Definition,retained historical D38/D65 source postures and owner fidelity of this translation remain separate;D65 exact older window and whole authoring file need qualified recovery evidence.
Evidence denotes a declared inspectable provenance-bound observation/record;actual inspection,origin authentication,support,weakening and evidence adequacy remain independent.
Claim,Time,CurrentnessCondition,Content and Assessment are descriptive carriers;no absent literal current Definition identities are invented.
Exact claim/subject/scope equality is a proposed bounded-association guard requiring accepted denotations and scope inclusion decisions,not a universal real-world scope algebra.
Observation and record are represented by one declared genus carrier;accepted subkind maps and actual evidence existence remain unresolved.
Support,weakening and unevaluability declarations are optional and scoped;they are not forced into an exclusive or exhaustive actual-force partition.
The four-place normative support relation and three-place formal supports notation require accepted projection correspondence;the latter is not silently merged as an extra axiom.
Nonempty provenance,content,time and currentness handles do not authenticate source bytes,epoch ordering,current conditions,origin or actual inspectability.

Silent current support requires mapped currentness agreement and no stale/mismatch declaration;stale evidence can remain a record and a separately assessed historical support declaration. No blanket stale-evidence invalidity axiom is imported.
Evidence is independently sorted from Claim and excludes ClaimItselfRole and ProofByExistenceRole;cross-artifact concrete identity maps and actual proof still need independent acceptance.

Declared Decision/Authority/Admission/Conformance roles need an included exact applicable-assessment record as a necessary condition;such labels and an assessment declaration do not create an actual governing outcome.
Existence,collection and volume do not establish sufficiency,proof,truth,acceptance,admission or authority;separately supported actual outcomes may coexist without being entailed by T.

No admitted-current Artifact Type directly binds this exact Evidence Definition in the inspected catalog;generic Definition shape and other evidence-producing carriers cannot be substituted as its accepted instance contract.
